newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan issues tender to sell June fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan issues tender to sell June fuel oil.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to sell 30,000 tonnes of 3.0-percent sulphur fuel oil for June lifting, industry sources said on Wednesday.
CPC is seeking to sell the cargo for June 2-27 lifting from Kaohsiung on a free-on-board (fob) basis, the sources said
The tender closes on May 14 and is valid until May 16.
In its last sell tender, CPC sold 30,000 tonnes of high sulphur fuel oil at below $100 per tonne for lifting May 27-31 on a fob basis.
